configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.displayName: Release with Ninja, tests and install on
configurePresets.description: Reproduces the configuration this repository is verified with on the development machine (MinGW g++). Build output goes under .tmp/, so no IDE grows cmake-build-* in the repository root again. Using presets needs CMake 3.21 or newer; the library itself still needs only 3.17.

configurePresets.name: static
configurePresets.description: The second measured leg: the archive a consumer links into its own shared object, which is why POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE is forced on in that configuration.

configurePresets.name: sanitize
configurePresets.description: What the Linux sanitizer leg of CI runs. The option refuses to configure when the toolchain cannot build with the sanitizer runtimes, rather than quietly producing an uninstrumented build.
